cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a WIFI Test Engineer (Wireless Engineer III) to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Participates in wireless network planning, wireless network architecture design and engineering. Integrates and schematically depicts communication architectures, topologies, hardware, software, transmission and signaling links and protocols into complete wireless network configurations. Evaluates new products, performs wireless network problem resolution. Develops and implements approved methods of procedure. Designs, develops and implements wireless network enhancements and makes recommendations for improvement. Performing planning, forecasting, implementation, and identification of resource requirements for wireless network systems of high complexity. Designs, develops and implements wireless network enhancements and makes recommendations for improvement. Responsible for implementation of wireless network architecture and designs.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proficient data wireless networking knowledge (OSI Model, TCP/IP, etc.)
Proficient knowledge of related wireless industry specifications and standards IEEE, ANSI, 802.11 variants, Bridging, Switching, Routing, Ethernet and Transport technologies and protocols
Proficient knowledge in wireless network design, wireless network architecture, protocols and wireless network topology
Proficient knowledge of basic wireless network devices and basic wireless network appliances
Proficient knowledge of wireless network designing software, such as Visio and knowledge of Microsoft Office
Must come from a Telecom background or a manufacturer for Routers or parts inside of them
Must have experience doing end to end testing of Wi-Fi hardware within a lab environment
5+ Years of Wireless Network experience
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Cisco Certified Wireless Network Professional (CCNP)
Wireless industry and vendor specific training (Cisco, Ariss, Ruckus, etc.)
5–10 Years of experience

Cisco Certified Wireless Network Professional (CCNP), or willingness to obtain.

cond_0395.intro: We are looking for a WIFI Test Engineer (Wireless Engineer III) to join our team.
cond_0395.responsibilities: Lead wireless network planning, architecture design, and engineering. Execute integration and schematic depiction of communication architectures, topologies, hardware, software, transmission and signaling links, and protocols into complete wireless network configurations. Drive evaluation of new products and own wireless network problem resolution. Develop and implement approved methods of procedure. Design, develop, and deliver wireless network enhancements and determine recommendations for improvement. Take ownership of planning, forecasting, implementation, and identification of resource requirements for wireless network systems of high complexity. Direct implementation of wireless network architecture and designs.
cond_0395.requirements:
Proficient data wireless networking knowledge (OSI Model, TCP/IP, etc.).
Proficient knowledge of related wireless industry specifications and standards IEEE, ANSI, 802.11 variants, Bridging, Switching, Routing, Ethernet and Transport technologies and protocols.
Proficient knowledge in wireless network design, wireless network architecture, protocols and wireless network topology.
Proficient knowledge of basic wireless network devices and basic wireless network appliances.
Proficient knowledge of wireless network designing software, such as Visio and knowledge of Microsoft Office.
Must come from a Telecom background or a manufacturer for Routers or parts inside of them.
Must have experience doing end to end testing of Wi-Fi hardware within a lab environment.
5+ Wireless Network experience.
Cisco Certified Wireless Network Professional (CCNP).
Wireless industry and vendor specific training (Cisco, Ariss, Ruckus, etc.).
5–10 Years of experience.
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field or equivalent work experience.

cond_0600.intro: We are looking for a WiFi Test Engineer to join our team.
cond_0600.responsibilities: A large part of this role involves working across wireless network planning, architecture design, and engineering. You will regularly connect with team members to integrate and schematically depict communication architectures, topologies, hardware, software, transmission and signaling links, and protocols into complete wireless network configurations. You will evaluate new products, actively contribute to wireless network problem resolution, and develop and implement approved methods of procedure. The role involves designing, developing, and implementing wireless network enhancements, and speaking up with recommendations for improvement. You will stay engaged in planning, forecasting, implementation, and identification of resource requirements for wireless network systems of high complexity. You will also be responsible for implementing wireless network architecture and designs.
cond_0600.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proficient data wireless networking knowledge (OSI Model, TCP/IP, etc.)
Proficient knowledge of related wireless industry specifications and standards: IEEE, ANSI, 802.11 variants, Bridging, Switching, Routing, Ethernet, and Transport technologies and protocols
Proficient knowledge in wireless network design, architecture, protocols, and topology
Proficient knowledge of basic wireless network devices and appliances
Must come from a Telecom background or a manufacturer for Routers or parts inside of them
Must have experience doing end-to-end testing of Wi-Fi hardware within a lab environment
5+ Years of wireless network experience
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
Preferred Requirements
Proficient knowledge of wireless network designing software such as Visio, and Microsoft Office
Cisco Certified Wireless Network Professional (CCNP)
Wireless industry and vendor-specific training (Cisco, Ariss, Ruckus, etc.)
5–10 Years of experience
